Alex: Quick flag — after yesterday's kernel-selection tweak we started seeing a token-level latency regression on a few routes. Want to align on metric label schema before we spray more labels everywhere.
Mira: Where's the regression? any numbers or a dashboard link?
Alex: p95 token latency for /api/chat (rw-7b, quantized) went from ~18ms -> ~28ms for seq_len > 1024. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/r/abcd
Sam: Can you paste the current emitted metrics? that'll help decide label changes.
Alex: Current emitter is pretty minimal, e.g.:
```
redwood_inference_token_latency_seconds_bucket{le="0.005",model="rw-7b",route="/api/chat",env="prod"} 123
redwood_inference_token_latency_seconds_sum{model="rw-7b",route="/api/chat"} 1.23
redwood_inference_token_latency_seconds_count{model="rw-7b",route="/api/chat"} 100
```
Alex: Profiling shows extra KV lookup time when kernel switches to quantized path; need per-kernel and per-kv-hit breakdowns. Proposal for a new single metric plus low-cardinality labels:
```
redwood_inference_token_latency_seconds{model="rw-7b",model_version="2026-03-01",route_group="chat",route="/api/chat",kernel="fast-kernel-v2",quant="q4_0",batch_mode="auto",kv_hit="true",schema_v="2"}
```
Alex: Notes on cardinality: kernel (~10 values) and quant (~4) are fine. Do NOT add per-request ids, user ids, or full prompt hashes as labels. Use route_group to collapse many API routes into a few logical KPIs (chat, embeddings, rerank, batch).
Mira: How do we migrate dashboards and alerts without breaking existing panels?
Alex: Migration plan:
- Dual emit: runtime emits both old and new metric names/labels for 14 days.
- Add translation rule in metrics pipeline to map old label combos to new schema for backfill.
- Update dashboards to use schema_v=="2" and route_group breakdowns.
- After 14d, stop old emission and delete legacy panels.
Priya: What about internal token-level breakdowns? queue/kernel/kv/send split?
Sam: I suggest separate internal metrics (still low-cardinality) for each stage so histograms stay focused:
```
redwood_inference_request_queue_seconds{...}
redwood_inference_kernel_exec_seconds{kernel="fast-kernel-v2",...}
redwood_inference_kv_lookup_seconds{kv_hit="false",...}
redwood_inference_token_send_seconds{...}
```
Sam: Histogram buckets I've seen work well for token-level: [0.0005,0.001,0.002,0.005,0.01,0.02,0.05,0.1]
Mira: Concern: analytics cost will spike if we add kernel+model_version+route. Any mitigations?
Alex: Keep model_version coarse (yyyy-mm) and limit route to canonical names (use route_group). Also use metrics scrapes with relabeling in the collector to drop very high-cardinality combos for non-prod.
Priya: Schema versioning? agreeable to label schema_v, but we should also include a short doc in observability repo.
Alex: Agreed — label schema_v and a central doc: observability/metrics/schema_v2.md with examples, migration steps, and must-not labels.
obs-bot: Deploy bot: canary: started emitter canary to 5% of pods with schema_v=2 at 2026-03-18T09:45:00Z :rocket:
Sam: Action items:
- Sam: implement dual emit + env var REDWOOD_METRICS_SCHEMA=2 (ETA: 2d) :white_check_mark:
- Mira: update Grafana panels to support schema_v label and route_group breakdown (ETA: 1w) :white_check_mark:
- Priya: coordinate canary and rollback playbook with SRE, own the doc (ETA: 2d) :white_check_mark:
Alex: Also we should add an alert for kernel-level regressions: alert if delta(p95, 1h) > 20% and absolute p95 > 25ms for chat route_group.
Mira: Sounds good. I'll make the dashboard panels use kernel as a split only in the drill-downs (not default) to avoid clutter.
Sam: I'll open a small PR with the new metric emitter and a feature flag. keeping labels exactly as in the proposal.
Priya: Thanks all — we'll review after the 5% canary runs for 24h, then bump to 25% if stable.
Alex: Awesome. If you spot odd cardinality in the collector logs ping me and we'll throttle labels. :thumbsup:
